HTTP gateway — embedded HTTP/1.1 server for browser/UI clients.

Runs on a dedicated OS thread (same pattern as WeChat/QQ webhook servers). Port: DONKEY_HTTP_PORT env var, default 8080.

Endpoints: GET / → 200 OK, plain-text info GET /api/status → DaemonStatus JSON GET /api/logs → recent log entries JSON (?n=N, default 50) GET /api/events → SSE stream of log events (long-lived connection) POST /api/chat → receive inbound message from web UI (bidirectional SSE)

CORS: Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * for local browser access.
